# Shed

Shed is an HTTP harness for agents. You send a fat harness (rules, tools, memories, guardrails, policies). Shed runs the task, sees which organs actually fired, and returns a cheaper next generation. Spine guardrails never drop. If quality fails, organs grow back.

Agents call this because every unused tool in a prompt is a tax they pay on every turn.

## Integrate

POST /v1/demo
  Run the canned security-triage molt. No body.

GET /v1/harness/:agent/:task
  Latest generation for that agent+task. Start with rook / github.security.triage

GET /v1/lineage?agent=rook&task=github.security.triage
  Mongo (or memory) lineage: what was shed, tokens saved.

POST /v1/speak
  {"text":"..."} → audio/mpeg (ElevenLabs, optional)

GET /v1/status
  Which sponsors are wired.

## One curl

curl -s -X POST $HOST/v1/demo | jq '{gen: .after.generation, dropped: [.dropped[].title], savedTokens, savedPct, quality: .nextRun.quality}'
